skill.name: agy-worker
skill.description: Use when Codex or Claude Code should delegate repository exploration or implementation to Google Antigravity CLI (agy), then review, verify, repair, and deliver the result.
skill.summary: Delegate bounded repository tasks to Antigravity CLI, then independently review changes and record verification.
skill.author: cagdasyurekli

security_audit.summary: Most reviewed matches are validation controls, local evidence handling, type annotations, or documentation rather than malicious behavior. Provider dispatch and candidate verification retain user-authority execution risks; native mode also permits broader network and Keychain access. No evidence found of malicious exfiltration or auditor-targeted prompt injection; 280 omitted static matches still require manual review before automatic publication. Static review was capped at 400/680 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 280 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.issue: Session-mode provider execution retains ambient user authority.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit session-risk confirmation and recommend an isolated account or disposable host when native containment is unavailable.

remediation.issue: Candidate verification can affect files and networks outside the candidate.
remediation.suggestion: Offer isolated verification by default, with denied network and credentials; retain explicit acknowledgements for broader execution.

remediation.issue: Native Keychain access is broader than a single provider credential.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated credential store or narrow broker instead of exposing general Security services and an unrestricted security helper.

remediation.issue: Native networking allows destinations beyond the approved provider.
remediation.suggestion: Enforce destination policy through a restricted proxy or equivalent network control, and remove unnecessary listener permissions.

remediation.issue: The static review omitted 280 additional matches.
remediation.suggestion: Complete manual adjudication of omitted matches before automatic publication; keep the coverage warning until that review is recorded.

content.user_title: Delegate Repository Work and Verify Results
content.value_statement: Delegated repository changes need independent review before acceptance. This skill coordinates approved Antigravity CLI jobs, bounded repairs, and driver-owned verification.
actual_capabilities: Run offline prerequisite and installed CLI capability checks.
Preview selected-content or whole-worktree launch approval bindings before provider dispatch.
Coordinate explore, task, and project workflows with explicit cycle and runtime budgets.
Stage approved content and reconcile authorized changes from scoped jobs.
Track job status, preserve reviewable candidates, and support approved conversation repairs.
Bind driver-selected verification evidence to a candidate and record final acceptance status.
limitations: Live jobs require Bash, Python 3, Git, and an authenticated Antigravity CLI with provider network access.
Approved repository content can reach Google or Gemini; secrets and unrelated private files must be excluded.
Session mode is not host isolation; native containment requires supported macOS and retains documented network and Keychain limits.
Verification executes untrusted candidate code and does not prove general correctness or prevent all host-side effects.

use_cases.title: Explore an Unfamiliar Repository
use_cases.description: Delegate focused architecture discovery, then spot-check reported files and record remaining coverage gaps.

use_cases.title: Add Bounded Regression Tests
use_cases.description: Approve selected source and test files, restrict edits to tests, and independently verify the resulting candidate.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a Multi-Step Repair
use_cases.description: Use a project workflow to inspect failures, request same-conversation repairs, and finalize with driver-owned build, test, and lint evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Check Offline Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Use agy-worker to check offline readiness for [repository]. Report missing prerequisites. Do not dispatch a provider job or inspect account settings.

prompt_templates.title: Preview Focused Exploration
prompt_templates.prompt: Preview an agy-worker explore job for [question] using only [approved paths]. Show exact content scope, model, isolation, and budget. Wait for approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: review provider exposure before exploration

prompt_templates.title: Implement a Scoped Test Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a scoped agy-worker task for [test change]. Read [source paths] and edit only [test paths]. Request launch approval. Independently review and verify afterward.

prompt_templates.title: Manage a Bounded Repair Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan an agy-worker project job for [repair] with [scope], [model], [isolation], and [budget]. Obtain approval for transmission and scoped repairs. Verify independently before finalization.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate approved repairs and evidence

output_examples.input: Preview a parser-test task without sending repository content to the provider.
output: Launch preview prepared; provider dispatch has not started.
Proposed readable scope: parser source and parser tests.
Proposed writable scope: parser tests only.
Approval remains pending for the exact task, content digest, model, isolation mode, and budget.

output_examples.input: Summarize a candidate after the parser suite passes but lint is unavailable.
output: The candidate diff was reviewed and the selected parser suite passed.
Lint was not run because its required tool was unavailable.
Finalization records the stated assurance without committing or publishing changes.

best_practices: Prefer selected-content scope and review the exact launch approval before sending repository material.
Choose isolation and budgets explicitly; keep secrets, raw logs, and controller state outside approved provider content.
Inspect the actual candidate diff, run independent checks in an isolated copy, and record verification gaps before finalization.
anti_patterns: Treating installation, a preview digest, or an offline readiness check as permission for live provider dispatch.
Treating staging or a disposable worktree as a sandbox for session-mode execution.
Executing commands copied from worker reports or accepting a result without independent diff review.

faq.question: Which coding assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The package supports Codex CLI and Claude Code as driver hosts. Antigravity CLI performs the delegated work.

faq.question: Does installation authorize repository transmission?
faq.answer: No. The owner must approve the exact task, readable content, destination, model, isolation mode, and budget before live dispatch.

faq.question: Can I delegate only selected files?
faq.answer: Yes. Scoped jobs stage approved read entries and restrict reconciled edits to an approved write subset.

faq.question: Does a disposable worktree isolate the provider?
faq.answer: No. Session mode retains ambient user authority. Native containment requires supported macOS and has documented network and credential limitations.

faq.question: Can the worker approve its own output?
faq.answer: No. Worker reports and optional self-verification are advisory. The driver reviews the diff and chooses independent verification.

faq.question: What happens when a job fails or exhausts its budget?
faq.answer: Preserve reviewable candidates and report the blocking condition. Repairs require applicable approval, and direct-driver fallback must not happen silently.
